entries.name: Amaris Net
entries.content:
Description: The Amaris Net is a powerful magical artifact created by the Sorcerer Prince and worn on the entire body. It consists of metal chains, cuffs, necklaces, rings, etc. draped over the body without actually covering any skin or intimate parts, and inlaid with powerful enchanted gems that give several powers. It is a masterpiece of magical engineering and more expensive than some kingdoms to make, it has to be customized to match the wearer or it won't work
Powers:
- Enhancement: Depending on the enchanted gems it can offer a variety of enhancements like physical abilities, senses, mental, magical, etc.
- Teleportation: Allows to teleport to any place of the Sorcerer Prince palace with a thought, still works outside, but it is more limited
- Storage: It contains a subdimensional storage that can hold up to 5 m3 of non-living things.
- Slow Aging: The artifact melds with the body and slows down aging significantly, allowing lifespans of hundreds if not thousands of years. It cannot be removed without causing serious harm or death
- Alternative Form: The artifact has two forms, it can transform to cover the body properly when needed, complementing the original form's design and offering better protection than any armor
